Date: 2028-05-20T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: logo use + press quote for May launch

Thanks for the ping. Quick read of the customers redlines — high level suggestions below (attach stubbed redline PDF):

1) Publicity/Reference rights: propose we require Brightline to obtain prior written approval for any press release or public-facing case study that references Redwood. We can offer a 3-business-day review window for short press releases/quotes (to meet tight marketing timelines) but require 30-day notice for case studies and customer stories that include technical details.

2) Logo use: provide brand guidelines and a single approved SVG. Usage limited to marketing materials related to the joint announcement. Any broader reuse (website, third-party materials) requires separate permission. Include a simple brand-spec attachment.

3) Quote attribution: accept a short attributed quote but limit length (one-two sentences) and allow Redwood to review the exact wording. We should not grant a blanket right to create written case studies or benchmarks without separate consent.

4) MSA language: remove any clause that grants unfettered "reference rights" or allows the customer to publish case studies without additional approval. If the customer insists, require an explicit approval cycle and substitution language to protect Redwoods IP and marketing assets.

Action: Ill produce marked-up language by EOD and include a redlined MSA excerpt. For now, suggest we push for: prior written approval, 3-business-day review for release copy/quotes, 30-day review for case studies, and clearly defined logo usage limitations.

-Rishi
General Counsel (acting)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_publicity_redline_stub.pdf

From: Brightline Legal <legal@brightline.com>

Date: 2028-05-21T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Press and logo usage for Brightline announcement — MSA/Order Form redlines

Vanessa / Rishi,

Thanks for the suggested language. Brightline Legal can accept prior approval for press copy, however we have a few requests:
- For go-to-market timing we need a shorter approval window for release quotes. We propose 1-2 business days for short quotes, and were willing to accept 10 business days for case studies instead of 30.
- We also prefer language around "reasonable commercial efforts" rather than strict deadlines to avoid technical breakages.
- Regarding logo usage, Brightline asks for permission to host the Redwood logo on our partner page and in investor-facing materials.

Attached is our counter redline (Brightline_MSA_response_20280521.pdf). Would Redwood accept: 2 business day review for quotes, 10 business day review for case studies, and a carve-out to host a partner badge on Brightlines partner directory?

If we can trade off a slightly longer review for case studies (10 days) for the partner badge hosting, we think this addresses both teams timelines.

Best,
Brightline Legal
Attachments: Brightline_MSA_response_20280521.pdf

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Press and logo usage for Brightline announcement — final steps

Thanks all — good compromise. Summarizing agreed points so legal & procurement can close:

1) Press quotes & short releases: Brightline may publish joint announcement language that references Redwood provided Brightline sends final copy and art to Redwood for prior written approval. Redwood will endeavor to provide approval within 2 business days for short quotes/releases.
2) Case studies / extended customer stories: 10 business day review window (Brightline request accepted).
3) Logo hosting: Redwood grants permission to host a partner badge on Brightlines partner directory and in investor-facing materials; any other usage requires separate written permission.
4) No blanket right for written case studies or benchmarks; separate approval cycle required.

Action items:
- Brightline to upload final press copy to the Drive link and confirm partner-badge art by May 24 EOD (Anna).
- Redwood legal (rishi) to incorporate the compromise language into the MSA redline and return final PDF (ETA May 24 EOD).
- Procurement (dev) to confirm Order Form countersignature process and provide DocuSign link (ETA May 25 EOD).
- PR (marissa) to provide Redwood quote and approved SVG by May 25 EOD.

Attachments referenced above: Brightline_MSA_redlines_20280520.pdf, Brightline_MSA_response_20280521.pdf, OrderForm_Brightline_v2.docx

If there are no objections, I will ask legal and procurement to insert the agreed language into the final MSA/Order Form and routing for signatures.

Thanks — excited to get this live.
